newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans slip after Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans slip after Chicago.

text.p: Argentine cash soybeans were lower in tight trade at midsession on Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange as prices slid after falling Chicago soybeans, traders said.

The FAS elevator soybean price in Rosario lost $5 to $295. As usual, much supply was frightened away by the big price dip, choking off volume. Buenos Aires sunflower seed was dragged down $2 to $226 by soybeans, also in low volume. FAS elevator maize lost $2 to $106 in Quequen, with prices mainly weighed down by harvest supply but also pressured by a lower Chicago. Maize turnover was heavy.
